title: L3Cube-MahaNews: News-based Short Text and Long Document Classification Datasets in Marathi
reasoning: The paper focuses on the creation and benchmarking of a news classification dataset in the Marathi language. While 'Bhakti' (which includes horoscope, festivals, and spirituality) is one of the 12 categories in the dataset, the study is a standard document classification task and does not involve an evaluation or benchmarking of religious tenets, faith, theology, morals, or ethics.
